name: Kimchi Jjigae (김치찌개)
description: Kimchi stew. Aged kimchi, Pork belly or tuna, Tofu, Onion, Garlic, Gochugaru, Gochujang, Sesame oil, Green onion

name: Doenjang Jjigae (된장찌개)
description: Soybean paste stew. Doenjang, Tofu, Zucchini, Onion, Potato, Garlic, Green chili, Mushrooms, Anchovy or kelp broth

name: Sundubu Jjigae (순두부찌개)
description: Soft tofu stew. Soft tofu, Gochugaru, Garlic, Onion, Egg, Zucchini, Anchovy broth, Sesame oil

name: Galbitang (갈비탕)
description: Beef short rib soup. Beef short ribs, Garlic, Onion, Korean radish, Green onions, Salt, Black pepper, Glass noodles (optional)

name: Budae Jjigae (부대찌개)
description: Army base stew. Kimchi, Spam or hot dogs, Ramyeon noodles, Baked beans, Tofu, Gochujang, Garlic, Onion, Cheese, Green onions, Broth

name: Haemul Sundubu Jjigae (해물순두부찌개)
description: Soft tofu seafood stew. Soft tofu, Mixed seafood, Gochugaru, Garlic, Onion, Egg, Zucchini, Seafood broth
